The STONE model for the three-dimensional simulation of rockfall trajectories.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Rockfall, Stone, Hazard, Trajectories<br>
**Authors:** Fausto Guzzetti, Massimiliano Alvioli, Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Stone`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inElev` | raster file |  |  | The map of the digital elevation model (DEM). |
| `inSources` | raster file |  |  | The map of sources and stop areas: positive integer values are the number of trajectories simulated from the cell, -1 marks areas where boulders stop (e.g. lakes). |
| `inNormalRestitution` | raster file |  |  | The map of the normal restitution coefficient used at impact points, as integer percentage, from 0 (total energy damping) to 100 (elastic restitution). |
| `inTangentialRestitution` | raster file |  |  | The map of the tangential restitution coefficient used at impact points, as integer percentage, from 0 (total energy damping) to 100 (elastic restitution). |
| `inFriction` | raster file |  |  | The map of the rolling friction coefficient tan(beta) (e.g. 0.85 for alluvial deposits, 0.30 for bedrock). |
| `pStartVelocity` | double |  | `1.0` | The start velocity of the boulders [m/s]. |
| `pStopVelocity` | double |  | `3.0` | The velocity under which a boulder stops [m/s]. |
| `pAngleStochRange` | int |  | `10` | The variability of the start angle around the direction of steepest descent, as percentage of 45 degrees. |
| `pNormalRestitutionStochRange` | int |  | `10` | The variability of the normal restitution around the cell value, in percentage points. |
| `pTangentialRestitutionStochRange` | int |  | `10` | The variability of the tangential restitution around the cell value, in percentage points. |
| `pFrictionStochRange` | int |  | `10` | The variability of the friction coefficient around the cell value, in hundredths. |
| `pAngleStochFunction` | String |  | `Gaussian` | The distribution of the start angle around the direction of steepest descent. Allowed values: `Gaussian`, `Cauchy`, `Uniform`. |
| `pStochFunction` | String |  | `Gaussian` | The distribution of the restitution and friction coefficients around the cell values. Allowed values: `Gaussian`, `Uniform`. |
| `pStep` | double |  | `5.0` | The spatial step of the trajectories [m]: boulders are moved and recorded about every step. It is limited to the cell size. The results depend on it (finer steps give longer runouts), the default of 5 m is the one of the original model. |
| `pMaxTrajectories` | int |  | `1000` | The number of boulders, about, whose trajectories are stored, sampled over all sources (0 for none). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outCounter` | output file |  | The map of the number of trajectories passing through each cell. |
| `outMaxVelocity` | output file |  | The optional map of the maximum velocity of the boulders in each cell [m/s]. |
| `outMaxDz` | output file |  | The optional map of the maximum height of the trajectories over the ground in each cell [m]. |
| `outTrajectories` | output file |  | The optional vector file of the 3D lines of a sample of pMaxTrajectories trajectories, with the source cell, the maximum velocity [m/s] and the maximum height over the ground [m]. |

**References**

- Guzzetti, F., Crosta, G., Detti, R., Agliardi, F. (2002). STONE: a computer program for the three-dimensional simulation of rock-falls. Computers & Geosciences, 28(9), 1079-1093.
- Alvioli, M., et al. (2021). Rockfall susceptibility and network-ranked susceptibility along the Italian railway. Engineering Geology, 293, 106301.
